title: Feat/new range slider
body:
⚠️ merge first https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2107 I will re-open the PR after on the correct branch, this is just for keeping track of what is done and code review.

Use https://github.com/airbnb/rheostat as `range-slider` and should remove the usage of https://github.com/algolia/react-nouislider which is not meant to be maintained.

* fixes range slider issues with negatives values 🎉
* removes the "hacky" JS -> React bridge for nouislider
* tries to keep the same options as before for easy replacement for current client implementations
* fixes the wrong calculation of the "half" value (never got reported?)
